response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff Software Engineer with strong backend and distributed systems expertise, but he lacks the executive leadership experience required for a CTO role. He has not demonstrated a track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, managing managers, or operating at the board level. Additionally, his exposure to agentic AI and fintech infrastructure is too recent and limited to meet the hard requirements for this specialized, high-stakes domain.
strengths: Extensive hands-on backend experience with event-driven architectures and high-volume microservices.
Strong engineering fundamentals with a focus on TDD, CI/CD, observability, and software craftsmanship.
Recent hands-on exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling.
concerns: Zero executive leadership experience; no track record of scaling teams or developing a senior technical leadership layer.
Lacks deep production experience architecting complex, multi-agent AI systems for high-stakes commercial environments.
Limited fintech background with no mention of algorithmic working-capital, credit risk, or trade decisioning systems.
